get_latest_auction.description: Get the most recent auction results of one regular Treasury security, such as the 10-Year Note or the 13-Week Bill, reopenings included: its high yield or rate, bid-to-cover ratio and who bought. No API key required.
get_latest_auction.name: get_latest_auction

parameters.description: The security, by term and kind.
parameters.name: security

accepted_amount.description: Bids accepted within the offering, in dollars of face value. Empty for auctions before 2008.

allotted_at_high_percent.description: The share of each bid made at the high yield, rate or margin that was filled, in percent.

announcement_date.description: The day Treasury announced the auction.

bid_to_cover_ratio.description: Dollars bid for each dollar accepted, e.g. 2.41. Higher means more demand.

competitive_accepted.description: Accepted competitive bids (bids naming a yield or rate), in dollars.

competitive_close_time.description: When competitive bids close on the auction day, Eastern Time, e.g. '01:00 PM'.

cusip.description: The security's CUSIP, the 9-character id it trades under, e.g. '91282CRR4'. A reopening has the same CUSIP as the original.

days_to_maturity.description: Days from the issue date to the maturity date.

description.description: What TreasuryDirect calls it, e.g. '5-Year TIPS', '13-Week Bill' or '9-Year 10-Month Note' (a reopened 10-year note).

direct_bidders_accepted.description: Competitive bids accepted from direct bidders, who bid for their own account, in dollars. Empty before 2008.

federal_reserve_accepted.description: Bought by the Federal Reserve for its own portfolio (SOMA), on top of the offering, in dollars.

high_discount_margin.description: The highest accepted discount margin of an FRN auction, in percent.

high_discount_rate.description: The highest accepted discount rate of a bill auction, in percent.

high_investment_rate.description: A bill's high discount rate as a bond-equivalent yield, in percent, comparable with a note's yield.

high_yield.description: The highest accepted yield of a note, bond or TIPS auction, in percent; every winning bidder gets this yield.

index_ratio.description: For TIPS: the inflation index ratio on the issue date (principal grows by this factor).

indirect_bidders_accepted.description: Competitive bids accepted from indirect bidders, who bid through a dealer or bank (foreign central banks among them), in dollars. Empty before 2008.

interest_payment_frequency.description: How often interest is paid, e.g. 'Semi-Annual' or 'Quarterly'. Empty for bills, which pay no interest.

interest_rate.description: The coupon of a note, bond or TIPS, in percent a year. Set at the first auction; empty for bills and FRNs.

issue_date.description: The day the securities are issued and paid for.

issued_as.description: Bill, Note or Bond: what it is issued as. TIPS are notes or bonds, FRNs notes and cash management bills bills.

maturity_date.description: The day the security matures and is repaid.

noncompetitive_accepted.description: Accepted noncompetitive bids (bids taking whatever the auction sets, mostly individuals), in dollars.

noncompetitive_close_time.description: When noncompetitive bids close on the auction day, Eastern Time.

offering_amount.description: How much Treasury offered, in dollars of face value.

original_term.description: The term when the security was first issued, e.g. '10-Year' for a reopened 10-year note.

price_per_100.description: The price winning bidders pay per $100 of face value, in dollars.

primary_dealers_accepted.description: Competitive bids accepted from primary dealers, the banks that must bid at every auction, in dollars. Empty before 2008.

reference_cpi.description: For TIPS: the reference consumer price index on the issue date.

reopening.description: True when this auction sold more of an existing security.

results_published.description: True once the auction's results are out. Until then every result field below is empty.

results_url.description: The auction results press release (PDF), once results are out.

security_type.description: Bill, Note, Bond, TIPS, FRN (floating rate note) or CMB (cash management bill): the value the Security type filters take.

series.description: The note or bond series, e.g. 'AE-2031'. Empty for bills.

spread.description: An FRN's fixed spread over the 13-week bill rate it pays, in percent.

tendered_amount.description: Bids received within the offering, in dollars of face value. Empty for auctions before 2008, which TreasuryDirect reports only in total.

term.description: Time from issue to maturity, e.g. '13-Week' or '9-Year 10-Month'.

updated_at.description: When TreasuryDirect last changed this record, Eastern Time, e.g. '2026-10-22T14:49:14'.

description: Follow U.S. Treasury auctions from TreasuryDirect: upcoming auctions of bills, notes, bonds, TIPS and FRNs, auction results with the high yield or rate, bid-to-cover ratio and who bought, any security by CUSIP, and a search of every auction since 1979. Can start a workflow when an auction is announced or its results are out. No account or API key required.

treasurydirect_auction_announced_trigger.description: Runs when the U.S. Treasury announces an auction of bills, notes, bonds, TIPS or FRNs, with the security, auction date and amount offered. Optionally only one kind or term.

parameters.description: Only auctions of this kind: Bill, Note, Bond, TIPS, FRN or CMB. Leave blank for every kind.
parameters.name: security_type

parameters.description: Only auctions of this term, such as 13-Week or 10-Year (a note's or bond's reopenings included). Leave blank for every term.
parameters.name: term

treasurydirect_auction_results_trigger.description: Runs when the results of a U.S. Treasury auction are released, with the high yield or rate, bid-to-cover ratio and who bought. Optionally only one kind or term.

parameters.description: Only auctions of this kind: Bill, Note, Bond, TIPS, FRN or CMB. Leave blank for every kind.
parameters.name: security_type

parameters.description: Only auctions of this term, such as 13-Week or 10-Year (a note's or bond's reopenings included). Leave blank for every term.
